edge_explainer: CAUSE: Q4 FY-26 printed 2026-07-28 — revenue $3,658M above the guidance midpoint, GAAP EPS $1.04, non-GAAP $1.05 (a 1% gap, the cleanest in the cohort), FY26 revenue $13.58B / FCF $3.77B, and a Q1 FY-27 guide of $4.0B +/- $200M (+24.6% y/y) with non-GAAP EPS $1.16 (+23%) and the CEO calling trends 'strengthening' and momentum 'accelerating'. The stock fell 6.2% then 10.8%. So the DE-RATE mechanism is real: estimates rose, the multiple followed them down — the HUBS/CTSH/SAP form. THE LEVEL TEST FAILS. Trailing GAAP P/E at each fiscal-year end from XBRL: FY17 ~14x, FY18 ~18x, FY19 ~15x, FY20 ~24x, FY21 ~23x, FY22 ~14x, FY23 ~20x, FY24 ~40x, FY25 ~29x — a pre-AI median of ~18-19x. At $182.69 on FY26 EPS of $3.66 KLAC trades at 49.9x, ~2.6x that median; on sales, 17.7x TTM against a 3-year range of 6.8-18.3x, roughly the 95th percentile. After -40.6% it is still within a whisker of its own three-year maximum valuation — the drawdown returned it to where it traded in May-2026, which was already an all-time-high multiple. THE MISSING GATE (most portable output of this cohort): quality_drawdown.py measures the discount to a PRICE high and never to a MULTIPLE history. Adding 'disqualify if trailing EV/S or P/E is in the top quartile of its own 3y distribution' rejects KLAC, ARM and MRVL and passes PLTR and APP — the correct partition. EXHAUSTED fired and was right (+120.5% off an $82.86 low) but for the wrong reason: that low is 331 days old and the run was a genuine fundamental re-rating, so the decisive objection is the multiple percentile, not the path. MIX (Q3 FY-26 10-Q): China $829.6M, 24.3% of revenue, 31.2% for nine months — but China revenue is FLAT y/y (+0.3% over nine months) while total grew 10%, so the export-control tail is a LEVEL shock to ~$4B, not a growth shock. That is an anti-masking finding worth cataloguing: the China headline is less bad than it reads. The real risk is the opposite one — growth is Korea-led at +80% (memory/HBM) while Taiwan (leading-edge logic) is DOWN 12% and Japan down 47%. Memory capex is the most volatile leg of WFE; KLA's own revenue fell 20.9% y/y in the March-2024 quarter. CONFLICT: WFE lags the cycle by 2-4 quarters, so a 2027 credit break hits KLA's revenue in late-2027/2028 — meaning a -40% fall on rising guidance is precisely what the top of a semi-cap cycle looks like from the inside. The equity de-rates before the revenue confirms. Honesty read: fully CLEAN — nothing to catch, which under the honesty-alpha doctrine is explicitly not where the edge lives.
